result:
Round 502 is accepted and closed, and round 503 is planned as DPG-BUTTON-CLEANUP-2 stage 2b-3. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 502 acceptance**
- C passed every row, with real browser checks, 0 bugs, and its report-format check (L57) passing. The gate published commit `882854e` to both remotes.
- The three cart bugs are closed for the client path (D-29z1807): items hidden on phones (High), Checkout cut off on short desktop screens (Medium), and the mouse wheel not scrolling the cart columns (Medium).
- C's cart checks used stubbed API responses, so the real-backend check stays open as CART-REAL-BACKEND.
- New follow-ups (D-29z1808):
  - A's reviewer findings A-R502-CR-1…5 and C's card-width note go to the deferred Lows.
  - A gate note about Lenis's animation loop never being stopped becomes GATE502-I5-LENIS-RAF-LEAK (info).
  - Doc 323's status line used the wrong form (`In Progress` instead of `Completed (C round 502 PASS)`). That is my own task-text error from round 502, fixed by a one-line grant in round 503.

**Round 503 task** (`current-task.md`, baseline `882854e`, store worktree clean)
- **What changes:** A applies the reviewed sketch `b-round-502/sketch-503.patch.txt` (sha `210ee872…`). It moves the last three hand-rolled brass links onto the shared `buildButtonClassName`, using product-designer's mapping:

| Link | New style | Measured change |
|---|---|---|
| Cart "Upgrade" | primary `sm`, `min-h-11 shrink-0` | 104×32 → 104×44 px; the notice row grows 64 → 70 px on desktop; phone layout unchanged |
| Recordings "Create a scene" | primary `md` pill | stays 131×44 px; corners become a pill |
| Studio showcase "Browse the Collection" | primary `lg` pill, same as the Hero button | 257×58 → 241×48 px; the hover/press scale is removed |

- **Other files:** a new test file (12 tests, B2B3-0…7), two DESIGN_SYSTEM shape rows plus one sentence, the doc 323 status line, and a new doc 324.
- **Checks I ran on the sketch:**
  - typecheck, lint and Biome match HEAD;
  - the full suite (300 files, 4,353 tests) and the build pass;
  - all 16 mutants fail the expected tests.
- **Browser comparison, HEAD vs sketch** (1440, 1280 and 375 px):
  - the keyboard focus ring is unchanged;
  - mouse clicks on all three links reach the same pages as before;
  - cart Remove, Checkout and the round-502 cart journey give identical results;
  - the hand-rolled brass count drops from 104 hits / 41 solid to 100 / 38.
- **Review:** tech-lead approved v1 with conditions. The one Medium was three type assertions in my test, which break the project's rule; v2 fixes that and three Lows. v2, the dispatched version, was approved with no new findings.
- **Unchanged:** purchase protection (only class strings and imports change, no protected file is touched) and the persistent screen text.
- **C's checks:** C0–C14 in real Chromium. The cart and recordings rows use stubbed API responses; their real-backend half is marked BLOCKED (no backend in the cloud).

**Corrections and notes**
- **BC1b timing:** I first ruled that the BC1b test was at 51 % of a 5 s timeout. It actually declares a 20 s timeout, so it is at 13 % and there is no timing problem. The round-501 task had the same wrong "5 s default". Both are corrected in D-29z1811. Its test file stays out of round 503's own checks only because the code it tests (`Button.tsx`) is unchanged; the gate's full suite still runs it.
- **New deferred Low:** TL-R503-CART-NOTICE-375-SQUEEZE. On phones the ownership notice text is squeezed to 79 px beside the Upgrade button; this was already the case before this round. Stacking the button underneath would be a layout change, so it needs product-designer and Saba.
- **Saba:** no new questions. The Upgrade colour question (SABA-Q-502-UPGRADE-VARIANT) is still open; the default is brass and it doesn't block.
- **No architecture checkpoint:** the shared link-button wrapper and scanner signals are decided when stage 2 closes, after 2e.
- **Schedule:** REGRESSION is due on or after 2026-11-16 and goes first if planning happens then. RETRO is at round 510.

The advisor was available and consulted twice: after orientation and at the closing check. I did not modify any app source; the store tree is clean at `882854e`, and the second dev server and mock API I started are stopped.
